data.name: Atiyah
data.gender_notes: Atiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name given to a child born as a blessing or a gift from God. The name Atiyah carries the meaning “Gift from God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Atiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody gift from god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who is blessed by God
data.etymology: Atiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift from God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atiyah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
